en.name: LATAM Market Entry Policy Forum
en.description: Regulatory experts from both sides on cross-border investment, IP, and customs changes in 2026.
en.metaTitle: LATAM Market Entry Policy Forum | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Regulatory experts from both sides on cross-border investment, IP, and customs changes in 2026. Beijing, 20–21 January 2026.
en.overviewHtml: A policy forum bringing together regulatory experts from both sides to cover cross-border investment, IP, and 2026 customs changes.
en.whoShouldAttendHtml: Legal and compliance leads, trade policy officials, and market-entry teams from both regions.

cn.description: 中拉双方监管专家就跨境投资、知识产权及 2026 年海关政策变化展开讨论。
cn.metaTitle: 拉丁美洲市场准入政策论坛 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 2026年1月20–21日，北京，中拉双方监管专家就跨境投资、知识产权及 2026 年海关政策变化展开讨论。
cn.overviewHtml: 一场政策论坛，集合中拉双方监管专家，探讨跨境投资、知识产权及 2026 年海关政策变化。
cn.whoShouldAttendHtml: 来自中拉两地的法务与合规负责人、贸易政策官员以及市场准入团队。
cn.formatHtml: 包含监管论坛、与政策官员的问答环节，以及一对一法律咨询。
